=== A THIRD NEAR-MISS, CAUGHT ===
Reading the doc's two ledger lines I noticed both carry the SAME session_id (03c8c1e5-...) despite being presented as two separate `claude -p` runs, and I briefly treated that as possible single-session/fabricated evidence. I confirmed in core/lwb_core/ledger.py + events.py that session_id is carried through VERBATIM from Claude Code's hook payload and is NOT derived by the hook, which made the coincidence look worse. My own reproduction resolved it: BOTH of my runs reported session_id a80c5f61-756e-59bd-9b3e-d5735136360e, which is my OUTER container session's own id (it is literally the directory name of my scratchpad path). A nested `claude -p` in this environment inherits the enclosing session's id, and these are UUIDv5 (name-derived, note the '5' leading the third group), not v4. The doc's shared session_id is an environment artifact fully consistent with two genuinely separate runs. No finding; see observation 1.
